headline: Namibia Faces N$11.8 Billion Exposure to State-Backed Enterprise Debt
summary: Namibian public finances face N$11.8 billion ($650 million) in state-guaranteed debt liabilities as state-owned enterprises reduce government payouts and mining revenue contracts.
why: Sovereign guarantees for state enterprises pose acute fiscal risks for frontier markets, especially when commodity receipts decline.

impacts.name: Namibia
impacts.why: State-guaranteed SOE debt obligations pressure government fiscal buffers as mining income softens.
